# Real VRChat client-log lines from one launch, 2026-10-05, filtered to the lines roster.parse_line
# reads (player join/leave dropped); every usr_ and avtr_ id and every player and avatar name

# bursts, not only at the local avatar's accept. `## <block>` starts a block; the line before the
# first block is the launch's identity, fed ahead of every block.
